name: fix-remote-http-hardening
title: P2:远程HTTP韧性与不可信下载防护
description: 报告zot-remote四项合并(check-remote全CONFIRMED)。(1)韧性:http.rs:24-40仅timeout,无429/5xx retry/jitter/Retry-After;ensure_status(93-106)错误体全量拼入message无上限;对idempotent GET与带write token请求做bounded retry+尊重Retry-After+错误体限长sanitize。(2)API版本:全部请求无Zotero-API-Version header;固定支持版本纳入client config。(3)OA下载SSRF/资源:write.rs:298-351对第三方返回URL直接GET,无scheme/私网IP/redirect校验,.bytes()整包无size cap,无Content-Type/%PDF- magic校验;改https-only+redirect后重验IP+拒绝loopback/private+stream到temp+大小上限+PDF magic校验。(4)附件一致性:upload_attachment(zotero.rs:371-429)先建item后授权/上传,失败无清理留orphan,payload prefix+bytes+suffix再拼Vec内存翻倍;失败best-effort删除orphan并返回cleanup状态+流式/限制附件大小。(P3顺带:oa.rs:26-48,301-348正则解析arXiv Atom改streaming XML parser,可选)。
creator: lyh
